ymducttape.demo.title: YM Kit
ymducttape.demo.name: Name
ymducttape.demo.text.heading: Text
ymducttape.demo.text.wrapped: Wrapped text adapts its height to the width of the page. Everything is drawn by the active style, so another style changes every screen at once.
ymducttape.demo.list.heading: Scrolling
ymducttape.demo.picker.help: Drag in the field (saturation / brightness) or on the hue bar, or type a hex color or R/G/B values. Preview: new color left, the color it started with right.
ymducttape.demo.expandable.help: A row with an arrow on the right opens its control panel below it. While closed, the header can show the current values.
ymducttape.demo.expandable.advanced.text: Expanders can hold any element, also wrapped text and rows of buttons.
ymducttape.demo.lamp.help: Base modules for every lamp; add-on modules only where the lamp has the feature.
ymducttape.demo.style.heading: Styles
ymducttape.demo.style.help: Every element is drawn by the active style. The portal style replaces the window body with a starfield that follows the cursor; header and footer stay normal bars.
ymducttape.demo.style.saved: Style and colors are saved for all YM screens (config/ymducttape-client.json) when this screen closes.
ymducttape.demo.style.tints.help: Every star layer mixes these two colors in its own ratio. Changes show at once (with the Portal style).
ymducttape.demo.dialogs.heading: Dialogs
ymducttape.demo.dialogs.help: Dialogs darken the screen behind them; only their buttons, the close button or Escape close them.
ymducttape.demo.dialogs.confirm.title: Reset lamp?
ymducttape.demo.dialogs.confirm.message: All settings of this lamp go back to their defaults. This cannot be undone.
ymducttape.demo.dialogs.prompt.title: Rename
ymducttape.demo.dialogs.prompt.label: New name:
ymducttape.demo.segments.heading: Segments
ymducttape.demo.segments.reset.help: Change a value: the reset icon appears on the right and puts just this value back to its default.
ymducttape.demo.presets.heading: Presets
ymducttape.demo.presets.help: Click applies a preset, right click opens rename / recolor / delete, "+" adds the color from the color picker tab.
ymducttape.demo.presets.name: Name:
ymducttape.demo.preview.help: Drag to turn, right click resets the view, after a click the scroll wheel zooms.
ymducttape.demo.preview.custom.help: Left: the item from the item picker tab. Right: content a mod draws itself (e.g. particles of a particle editor).
ymducttape.demo.items.heading: Item & block picker
ymducttape.demo.items.help: Click a slot to choose with search ("@minecraft glass"), right click clears it.
ymducttape.demo.curve.heading: Startup flicker pattern
ymducttape.demo.curve.help: Drag points, click to add one, right click removes it, Shift snaps to the grid. The lamp below plays the pattern.
ymducttape.demo.config.heading: Generated config screen
ymducttape.demo.config.help: A mod marks the fields of its config class with @YmOption; the kit builds the screen (tabs per category, a fitting control per type, reset per value). Saved in config/ymducttape-demo.json.
ymducttape.demo.config.title: Demo config
ymducttape.demo.config.name: Name
ymducttape.kit.settings.reset.message: Put all settings of %s back to their defaults?
ymducttape.kit.settings.live: Changes apply at once and are saved when you close the screen.
